findings.claim: The boot cross-check reads declaredEngineRange from .totem/installed-packs.json, not from the pack's package.json, so widening the packs' engines ranges does not cure an already-installed consumer and the migration step 'update the engine and the packs together' is incomplete.
findings.counterexample: packages/core/src/pack-discovery.ts:366 copies entry.declaredEngineRange straight from the manifest (packages/core/CHANGELOG.md:1971 says the same), the pack's package.json is read only at sync time (packages/core/src/pack-manifest-writer.ts:132), and liquid-city's live .totem/installed-packs.json still records '^1.26.0' today while being gitignored with no postinstall totem sync.

findings.claim: The canonical searchRelevanceFloor docblock is a sixth surface still stating the unqualified 'in totem spec a single exempt hit saves the run', with no partition scoping anywhere in the block.
findings.counterexample: packages/cli/src/commands/spec.test.ts:1006 pins that a below-floor spec beside an FTS-only lesson still REFUSES, because floorExempt is counted only over specs/sessions/code at packages/cli/src/commands/spec.ts:702 - and the other five surfaces were qualified in this PR.

findings.claim: The claim that the new control makes 'a Version Packages PR go red if a cut ever walks out of a range again' overstates its coverage: '>=1.26.0 <3.0.0' spans two major lines, so the control is dormant for the entire 2.x line.
findings.counterexample: Measured against the production predicate: '>=1.26.0 <3.0.0' satisfies 2.0.0 and 2.9.9 and fails only at 3.0.0, whereas the replaced '^1.26.0' failed at 2.0.0 - the field no longer distinguishes major lines, and the changeset did not say so.

verdict: 0 BLOCKING, 1 MATERIAL, 2 MINOR over 58f919a7 (the F1 fold: pack engine ranges widened, structure tests run the boot predicate); all three folded in e2c17d80 - prose and one docblock only (the migration names the totem sync step because the boot check reads the sync-time manifest; the 2.x-wide coverage of the widened range disclosed; the key's own docblock qualified to the grounding partitions). The leg also verified the fold-2 controls mutation-style: the old range throws at 2.0.0 through the production path, the new one loads; the negative control throws before the engine seals; vitest isolates per file; the D1 matcher returns [] for every branch commit. Ladder terminates: the fold rewired no semantics.
